skill_name: Describe how a water cycle works.
workflow: The water cycle is the continuous movement of water through the environment that never stops. Water can take the form of a liquid, solid or gas as it moves through the different stages of the cycle. The water cycle begins with evaporation, which is when the sun heats up the surface of water bodies, forcing liquid water to change state and vaporize into the air.
